question.text: A 'Revocable Trust' implications on tax treatment:

answer.text: NOT eligible for tax pass-through — income taxed as that of the transferor under Section 61

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Section 61, for a revocable transfer of assets, income is charged as income of the transferor; a revocable-trust AIF is therefore not eligible for tax pass-through. The Trap: Pass-through, lower rates, or no-tax claims are incorrect — the revocable transfer attribution under Section 61 overrides them. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XIX-B AIF (Cat III) Distributors workbook, p.303 (with context on p.304).
